create_RunStudy_instance: create a RunStudy dataclass instance with total_line_num and optional error_lines and instances fields
serialize_RunStudy_to_json: serialize a RunStudy instance to JSON using the dataclasses_json to_dict or to_json method
deserialize_RunStudy_from_json: deserialize a RunStudy instance from JSON using the dataclasses_json from_dict or from_json method
access_RunStudy_instances: access the instances dictionary on a RunStudy object to retrieve InstanceFlow entries by key
inspect_RunStudy_error_lines: inspect the error_lines list and error_line_count on a RunStudy to review ERROR-level log lines
